userProfile.title: UserProfile
userProfile.description: Information stored on registration or first OAuth sign-in to persist custom account profile metadata

email.description: Primary email of the authenticated user

displayName.description: The user's readable display or greeting title

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating document creation time in Firestore

sessionLog.title: SessionLog
sessionLog.description: A custom-recorded session completion trace saved by the client

date.description: Strict ISO timestamp of the meditation session

technique.description: The specific technique delivered by Coach

rating.description: Optional post-session biofeedback feeling rating indicator

userId.description: Unique user email identifier corresponding to the logged user

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user registration and profiling details uniquely keyed or referenced by their lowercase email normalized identifier

/users/{userId}/history/{logId}.description: A subcollection containing historical logs completed by the specific user
